strings.Casi todo lo que haces en automático sig: Almost everything you do on autopilot follows the same pattern: something prompts you (the cue), you do something (the routine) and you get something you like (the reward). The brain repeats what pays off.
strings.Para crear un hábito nuevo, no empieces: To build a new habit, do not start with willpower: start by choosing a clear cue. “When I finish breakfast” works better than “in the morning”.
strings.Para quitar un hábito malo, localiza su: To drop a bad habit, find its cue and its reward. If you know what you are really looking for (rest, company, distraction), you can give yourself the same thing in another way.
strings.Un hábito es una señal que dispara una r: A habit is a cue that triggers a routine that gets rewarded. Change the design, not just the intention.
strings.Escribe la señal exacta de tu hábito pri: Write down the exact cue of your main habit: where you are, what time it is, what just happened.
strings.La mayoría abandona porque empieza con u: Most people quit because they start with a goal that is too big for a bad day. A tiny version of the habit survives even when you are tired.
strings.«Leer 30 minutos» pasa a ser «leer una p: “Read for 30 minutes” becomes “read one page”. “Exercise” becomes “put on my sneakers”. At the start, what matters is showing up, not performing.
strings.Cuando la acción mínima ya es automática: Once the minimum action is automatic, growing is easy: often you will keep going once you have started.
strings.Primero se construye el hábito de aparec: First you build the habit of showing up; intensity comes on its own later.
strings.Reduce tu hábito principal a una versión: Shrink your main habit to a version you can do in under two minutes.
strings.Apila sobre lo que ya haces: Stack on what you already do
strings.Engancha lo nuevo a lo viejo: Hook the new onto the old
strings.Ya tienes rutinas sólidas: despertarte,: You already have solid routines: waking up, brushing your teeth, making coffee, sitting down to work. They are free anchors.
strings.La fórmula es simple: «Después de [rutin: The formula is simple: “After [current routine], I will [new habit]”. The old routine works as a reminder and you do not depend on remembering.
strings.Elige un ancla que ocurra todos los días: Choose an anchor that happens every day and is about the same size as the habit. An anchor that sometimes does not happen leaves gaps.
strings.Una buena ancla vale más que cualquier a: A good anchor is worth more than any alarm.
strings.Tu entorno decide más de lo que crees. S: Your environment decides more than you think. If the guitar is in the closet, you will play less than if it is in plain sight.
strings.Para hábitos que quieres, quita pasos: d: For habits you want, remove steps: leave your workout clothes ready, the fruit within reach, the book on your pillow.
strings.Para hábitos que quieres evitar, añade p: For habits you want to avoid, add steps: delete the app from your phone, keep the remote in another room, sign out.
strings.Haz que lo bueno sea obvio y fácil, y lo: Make the good obvious and easy, and the bad invisible and hard.
strings.Cambia una cosa de tu casa o tu móvil ho: Change one thing at home or on your phone today so your habit costs one step less.
strings.Vota por la persona que quieres ser: Vote for the person you want to be
strings.«Quiero correr una maratón» es un objeti: “I want to run a marathon” is a goal. “I am a person who moves every day” is an identity. Goals end; identities remain.
strings.Cada vez que completas un hábito emites: Every time you complete a habit you cast a vote for that identity. You do not need unanimity, just a majority of votes.
strings.Por eso importa más no fallar los días m: That is why not failing on bad days with a minimal version matters more than shining on good days.
strings.Cada repetición es una prueba de quién e: Every repetition is proof of who you are.
strings.Termina la frase: «Soy una persona que _: Finish the sentence: “I am a person who ______” and do one action today that proves it.
strings.Fallar un día no rompe nada. Lo que romp: Missing a day breaks nothing. What breaks a habit is the “I have ruined everything” that comes after.
strings.La regla es sencilla: puedes saltarte un: The rule is simple: you can skip a day, but not two in a row. The second missed day is where a slip becomes quitting.
strings.Si no puedes hacerlo entero, haz la vers: If you cannot do the whole thing, do the minimum version. A streak that survives on the minimum is worth more than a perfect one that breaks.
strings.La constancia no es perfección: es volve: Consistency is not perfection: it is coming back quickly.
strings.Decide ahora cuál es tu versión mínima p: Decide now what your minimum version is for bad days.
strings.Un estudio de la University College Lond: A University College London study followed people adopting a new habit and found that, on average, it took about 66 days for it to become automatic.
strings.Pero la media esconde mucho rango: según: But the average hides a wide range: depending on the person and the habit, it took from around 18 weeks to quite a bit less. Simple habits take less time than complicated ones.
strings.Y fallar un día suelto no estropeó el pr: And missing a single day did not ruin the process. It is not a magic deadline: it is a reference for being patient.
strings.Dale tiempo: la automatización llega por: Give it time: automation comes through repetition, not all at once.
strings.Apunta la fecha de hoy como día 1 y revi: Write down today's date as day 1 and review your progress in two weeks.
strings.Lo que no es útil para la colmena, tampo: What is not good for the hive is not good for the bee.
strings.No es que tengamos poco tiempo, sino que: It is not that we have little time, but that we waste a lot of it.
strings.No son las cosas las que nos perturban,: It is not things that disturb us, but the opinions we have of them.
strings.Un viaje de mil millas comienza con un s: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
strings.No importa lo lento que vayas, mientras: It does not matter how slowly you go, as long as you do not stop.
strings.Somos lo que hacemos repetidamente. La e: We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence is a habit.
While we postpone life, it passes.
strings.Empieza la mañana diciéndote: hoy haré l: Start the morning by telling yourself: today I will do what is mine to do.
strings.El mejor momento para plantar un árbol f: The best time to plant a tree was twenty years ago. The second best time is today.
strings.Lo que obtienes al alcanzar tus metas no: What you get by achieving your goals is not as important as who you become.
strings.Haz hoy lo que puedas; mañana lo harás m: Do what you can today; tomorrow you will do it better.
strings.Quien mueve una montaña empieza apartand: He who moves a mountain begins by carrying away small stones.
Fortune helps those who are prepared.
strings.Primero di qué quieres ser; después haz: First say to yourself what you would be; then do what you have to do.
strings.Quien aprende y no piensa está perdido;: Learning without thought is lost; thought without learning is perilous.
strings.El obstáculo del camino se convierte en: The obstacle in the path becomes the path.
strings.Sufrimos más en la imaginación que en la: We suffer more in imagination than in reality.
strings.Hay cosas que dependen de nosotros y otr: Some things are up to us and some are not. Concern yourself only with the first.
strings.Dominar a otros es fuerza; dominarse a u: Mastering others is strength; mastering yourself is true power.
strings.Tienes poder sobre tu mente, no sobre lo: You have power over your mind, not over events. Realize this and you will find strength.
strings.Dificultades fortalecen la mente, como e: Difficulties strengthen the mind, as labor does the body.
strings.Quien tiene un porqué para vivir soporta: He who has a why to live can bear almost any how.
strings.La victoria se asegura antes de entrar e: Victory is secured before the battle is joined.
strings.Ve con confianza en la dirección de tus: Go confidently in the direction of your dreams; live the life you have imagined.
strings.Deja de discutir cómo debe ser un buen h: Waste no more time arguing what a good person should be. Be one.
strings.Nos asusta lo que no hemos probado; el m: We fear what we have not tried; fear dissolves when we act.
strings.La libertad no se consigue satisfaciendo: Freedom is not won by satisfying desires, but by removing the desire for more.
strings.Quien conoce a los demás es sabio; quien: He who knows others is wise; he who knows himself is enlightened.
strings.Puedes irte de la vida ahora mismo. Que: You could leave life right now. Let that determine what you do, say and think.
While we live, let us learn how to live.
